description: For financial advisors (requires a MySSAgent advisor account — sign in with your myssagent.com advisor account when prompted). Returns the stored Social Security claiming analysis for one of YOUR clients: optimal and recommended claiming ages, the benefit-by-claiming-age table computed from their Social Security earnings record, lifetime values, survivor analysis when present, and risk flags. Requires the advisor_client_id from list_clients — call that first when you only have a name. Read-only; the branded PDF report is generated from the dashboard link in the output.

advisor_client_id.description: The client's id from list_clients (a UUID).

name: get_client_report
title: Get a client's claiming analysis
